name: ws-p4-eth
title: Waveshare ESP32-P4-ETH
notes: ESP32-P4NRW32 (silicon v1.3), 32 MB flash, 32 MB PSRAM. Same Ethernet as the Guition P4: IP101 on the chip's MAC, IDF's P4 defaults (MDC 31, MDIO 52, REF_CLK in on GPIO50), PHY reset on GPIO51. microSD on SDMMC slot 0 (CLK 43, CMD 44, D0-D3 39-42), IO bank on LDO channel 4. Optional PoE module header. Power LED only: no LED the firmware can drive.
